record_type_quote: Precautions were taken to keep experimenter blind to condition: Prior to subject running, the Scrambled Sentence Task forms for each condition (elderly, neutral) were folded in thirds and (lightly) taped shut.

targets.authors: Bargh, J. A., Chen, M., & Burrows, L.
targets.title: Automaticity of social behavior: Direct effects of trait construct and stereotype activation on action.
targets.evidence_quote: The original study used 1 version of the scrambled sentence task for each condition. Since the order of the items on their version was unknown, the present study used 10 versions for each condition, to allow for greater randomization.
targets.outcome_quote: A t-test revealed that participants in the elderly priming condition walked faster (M=7.82, SD=1.03) than subjects in the neutral priming condition (M=8.06, SD=1.15). This difference was not significant, t(64) = -.88, p=.38.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Report labels the attempt Failure to Replicate. The measured nonsignificant difference is opposite to the original slowing effect.
